description: This file defines a JavaScript function 'fieldExpressionPopup' that manages a popup interface for editing field expressions in a CRM workflow module, including UI manipulation, AJAX calls to fetch module-specific data, and dynamic form element generation.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Hides the popup and clears the expression text.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the popup and centers it on the screen.

methods.name: center
methods.description: Centers a given element on the screen.

methods.name: showElement
methods.description: Shows a DOM element with specified display type.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Applies a function to each item in a list and returns the new list.

methods.name: implode
methods.description: Joins array elements into a string separated by a specified separator.

methods.name: handleExpressionType
methods.description: Handles UI changes based on the selected expression type.

methods.name: setFieldType
methods.description: Configures input fields based on the selected field type, including picklist, integer, date, time, etc.
